package.name: athome_hri_cpp
package.description: Production C++17 Speech Recognition (STT) stack for RoboCup@Home: PortAudio capture + Adaptive Noise-Floor VAD + CPU Denoising Frontend (DeepFilterNet2/RNNoise/Wiener-Spectral + 120Hz HPF) + Silero Neural VAD (ONNX Runtime CPU) + whisper.cpp (CUDA/CPU) + N-Gram Deduplication.
